remaining_limits: One self-authored new task is not a broad generalization estimate or teacher-held-out score.
The first proposal failed raw-value fidelity after a delegated paraphrase drifted from the original task. Final 12/12 followed explicit technical feedback and repair.
43 call durations sum to 211.29 seconds including tools, but actual task wall time is 2653.22 seconds including review/idle; neither predicts classroom runtime.
The dedicated ZIP adapter remains bound to the original mid-test directory/role/README protocol, including original HTML exception metadata. An unknown final package must be mapped independently.
Generic TXT intake uses the default team; it must not silently replace roles explicitly assigned by the teacher.
New quality edit tools and streaming change fresh-session bindings. Older sessions require their recorded source/configuration; do not silently resume them under changed tools.
Fault resend requires a reason and one explicit operator decision. It never auto-replays uncertain tool effects.
Full arbitrary-format intake, autonomous semantic correctness, and improved memory learning are not established.
